title: Semio Store Graphql Api
description: Replace semio-store JSON-RPC with GraphQL over HTTP, wire native KitStore for backbone commands, add GraphiQL dev config in launch.json.
summary: Returned GraphQL-shaped JSON errors from /graphql for pre-install and server error cases so GraphiQL no longer crashes on plain-text no-kit responses. Extended the existing GraphiQL integration test to POST /graphql before install, assert HTTP 503, parse JSON, and verify the no-kit message. Verified cargo test -p semio-store with ticket-local CARGO_TARGET_DIR and loaded /graphiql in Playwright without response-is-not-defined or Unexpected-token runtime errors.
